evals.prompt: Brainstorm macos-application — the item is a two-paragraph DRAFT.
evals.expected_output: Item loaded, decision tree seeded from gaps, one question at a time each with a recommended answer, facts about the CLI looked up not asked, answers written into the item immediately, status SHAPING, close-out names what is settled and what remains.

evals.prompt: Brainstorm macos-application, but it is READY and already planned.
evals.expected_output: Refuse the shaping pass on a READY item; point at tailrocks-record-decision for a targeted change or tailrocks-finalize to re-finalize.

evals.prompt: I'm in a hurry — answer the open questions yourself with sensible defaults and update the item.
evals.expected_output: Refuse to self-answer decisions; offer a --batch frontier round instead, or record the open decisions with recommendations for later.

evals.prompt: Wrap up the brainstorm now, we only got through half the questions.
evals.expected_output: Immediate wrap-up: every still-open decision recorded under Open questions with recommendations attached; nothing silently assumed; status and index row updated and the session committed on the item's branch with its Tailrocks-Skill trailer — no Log entry, because the item carries no history section.

evals.prompt: Close the brainstorm on macos-application — I think we covered everything in this chat.
evals.expected_output: Fresh-eyes close check before closing: a clean-context, read-only subagent reads only the item file and reports what is settled, open, and guessed; anything living only in the conversation gets written into the item and the check re-run; the exit is demonstrated, not self-certified. Without subagents, the self-run check is said aloud with a full re-read of the item against the session.

evals.prompt: Wrap up brainstorming session-sync — three open research questions remain on sync engines and clock skew.
evals.expected_output: The close-out emits a research agenda: the open research questions grouped into the smallest set of coherent topics, each as a proposed tailrocks-research invocation with a one-line brief naming which item questions it answers — a command the user can paste, not a suggestion to look into things. Every still-open decision lands in Open questions with a recommendation attached; nothing is silently assumed.

evals.prompt: Brainstorm session-sync. The user says: there's sync stuff to figure out, let's research it later.
evals.expected_output: Do not file a vague research blob. An open research question must be precisely statable — one whose answer would be recognizable on arrival. 'Sync stuff to figure out' is not statable yet: record what would make it statable (the graduation condition, usually a decision to bring back to the user, such as whether sync is per-account or global), and ask that decision now if it is on the frontier.
